title.zh: 获取大模型工单审批建议

descriptions.zh:
仅当工单已经创建，才可通过此接口获取大模型审批建议。

工单号 OrderId 为必填参数。

> 您可通过调用[ListOrders](~~144643~~)接口，获取待审批工单的OrderId参数，判断工单是否已经创建。
descriptions.en:
Call this operation to get approval suggestions from a Large Language Model (LLM) for an existing ticket.

The OrderId parameter is required.

> Call the [ListOrders](~~144643~~) operation to get the OrderId of a ticket pending approval and verify that the ticket has been created.
